notes: 📖 Reader view: ⋮ → Reader shows just the article in big, comfy text. Pick the size, Serif or Sans, and Light, Sepia or Dark
🔊 Listen: TP Browser reads pages out loud and highlights each paragraph as it goes. TP AI answers have a Listen button too
🎤 Talk instead of typing: tap the mic in search or in TP AI
🖼️ Picture-in-picture: leave TP while a video plays and it keeps playing in a small window
🌙 Dark mode for websites: ⋮ → Dark mode on this site turns bright pages dark, and pictures keep their colours
🌐 Translate whole pages into Thai, English and more, and 📷 save screenshots of pages to your Photos
🔳 Share a page with a QR code, ➗ do quick sums right in the search bar, and 🔥 see your Focus streak
✨ Smoother everything: menus spring up and swipe away, taps ripple, the home page glides in, and swiping the address bar slides between tabs
